code: (() => { const clean = (s) => (s || '').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim(); const sel = document.querySelector('.position-selecter') || document; const cols = [...sel.querySelectorAll('[class*=wrap],[class*=content]')].filter((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 40 && r.height > 40; }); const items = [...sel.querySelectorAll('.position-item')].map((e) => clean(e.innerText)).filter(Boolean); return {colsFound: cols.length, items: items.slice(0, 60), full: clean(sel.innerText).slice(0, 900)}; })()
